name: TeamsBlockTrialTenants
label: Block communication with trial-only Teams tenants
helpText: Controls whether users can chat, call and meet with accounts in Teams tenants that have no purchased seats (trial-only tenants). Microsoft blocks this by default since July 2024 because threat actors abuse trial tenants; this standard keeps it blocked. When blocked, users from trial-only tenants are removed from existing chats.
executiveText: Stops attackers who spin up free trial Teams tenants from reaching employees through chats, calls and meetings, closing an entry point used for phishing and malware delivery.
docsDescription: Sets ExternalAccessWithTrialTenants on the tenant federation configuration (Teams admin center > External access > Organization settings > 'People in my organization can communicate with accounts in trial Teams tenant').
